days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Caldara di Manziana
stops.detail: The natural monument of the Caldara di Manziana extends for 90 ha and is located at the extreme foothills of the Sabatino volcano.

stops.name: fosso della Caldara
stops.detail: The area is interesting due to the presence along the Caldara stream of forests of black alder, Turkey oak, Hungarian oak, downy oak, Montpellier maple, field elm, and black hornbeam.

days.title: UNESCO Peaks and Low-Altitude Beech Forests
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: monte Termine
stops.detail: The most important locations are Mount Termine (590 m) and Mount Raschio (552 m).

stops.name: monte Raschio
stops.detail: A UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site, it is a beech forest with an extension of 73.73 ha that is part of SIC IT6010034 and has the peculiarity of growing between 450 m and 552 m above sea level on Mount Raschio, elevations much lower than the beech forests of the Apennines which grow above 900 m.
